purpose: Define validation that Expose human-facing UI strings are either registered labels or explicitly exempt non-translatable data, preventing hidden hard-coded interface text.

topics.name: Localization Extraction Validation
topics.purpose: Define validation that Expose human-facing UI strings are either registered labels or explicitly exempt non-translatable data, preventing hidden hard-coded interface text.

semantics.literal_rule: Machine-generated data/user content is not automatically a translatable label.
semantics.ui_rule: Static human-facing Expose labels/help/navigation text must resolve through the label registry unless explicitly exempt.
semantics.identifier_rule: Internal IDs/commands are validated against accidental localization.
semantics.coverage_rule: Missing translation is a coverage finding, not permission to duplicate hard-coded text.
semantics.release_rule: Required-surface extraction violations block localization-ready lock according to profile.
semantics.report_rule: Finding identifies exact UI/source file/MetaModule and label/context target.

invariants.rule: Localized labels are context-bearing presentation resources mapped to stable canonical identities; translation never changes command names, internal identifiers or semantic identity.

hard_gates.condition: hard-coded required UI label accepted silently
user data mistaken for translation key
missing translation fixed by duplicate literal
